decisions.because: Counterexample on 3c51594 (ROADMAP item 10, round-5 mesh candidate): after RELOAD_PEERS revoked node 2 and bound node 3 elsewhere, both still received every broadcast until their own next envelope failed (up to ~10 s); a_reload_stops_broadcasts_to_a_revoked_or_moved_node_at_once saw [2, 3, 4] reached instead of [4].

statement: A reload that stops pinning a connected node, or binds it to an address it is not connected from, unregisters its connections at once: no broadcast of this node reaches it after the reload, and the audit record PEERS_RELOADED names those nodes (Unregistered). Their connections still close on their next envelope (MESH-A2).
